news.headline: Tulane wins its home opener 28-24
news.summary: Jaylin Lucas ran for 214 yards, including an 80-yard touchdown. Kadin Semonza threw a 14-yard touchdown pass to Destyn Hill with 1:17 left to put Tulane ahead for good.

news.headline: Tulane wears Mardi Gras uniforms Saturday night
news.summary: Tulane plays South Alabama at home Saturday night in green, purple and gold uniforms made for Mardi Gras. The helmet shows the Angry Wave in a jester hat with beads around it, and the back of the helmet reads "Uptown."

news.headline: Tulane names a new starting quarterback
news.summary: Coach Will Hall said Tuesday that Kadin Semonza will start Saturday against South Alabama. Semonza came off the bench at halftime at Duke and led Tulane's only scoring drive.

news.headline: Sumrall is not satisfied after the big win
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said he still feels uneasy about his team even after a 52-3 win. Florida starts its conference schedule next Saturday at Auburn.

news.headline: Florida rolls past Campbell 52-3
news.summary: Vernell Brown III ran two punts back for touchdowns, something no Florida player had done in one game since 1996. Jadan Baugh ran for 136 yards and two more scores, and the Gators are 2-0.

news.headline: Two Gators are out against Campbell
news.summary: Receiver Davian Groce is out with a hurt back and running back Kelvin Jimenez is out for the rest of the season. Receiver Eric Singleton, running back Evan Pryor and tight end Evan Chieca are all listed as maybes for Saturday's game.

news.headline: Texas beats No. 1 Ohio State 24-23
news.summary: Texas was losing 23-3 in the fourth quarter and scored three touchdowns to win. Hollywood Smothers ran the last one in from the 1-yard line with 25 seconds left.

news.headline: Arch Manning starts the comeback
news.summary: Manning completed 23 of 37 passes for 195 yards, with one touchdown and one interception, and ran the ball eight times. His touchdown pass to Ryan Wingo early in the fourth quarter began the rally.

news.headline: Cole Hutson can play against Ohio State
news.summary: The NCAA cleared the Texas lineman on Saturday, a week after the school said he was not eligible. He is not expected to start, but he is available if Texas needs him.

news.headline: Audric Estimé goes on injured reserve
news.summary: The Saints put running back Audric Estimé on injured reserve Saturday, so he will miss at least the first four games. They also signed tight end Treyton Welch and moved up receiver Kevin Austin Jr. and running back CJ Donaldson from the practice squad for Sunday at Detroit.

news.headline: Kellen Moore returns to the team he started with
news.summary: The Saints head coach began his playing career in Detroit in 2012 as an undrafted quarterback and stayed three seasons. New Orleans opens the season at Detroit on Sunday.

news.headline: Tyler Shough starts his second season as a captain
news.summary: Quarterback Tyler Shough is the starter again this year, and his teammates voted him one of the team captains. He now gives the speech in the huddle before games, a job Drew Brees used to have.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher has her best day of the season
news.summary: Peyton had 8 kills in Friday's win over Millersville, more than anyone else on the team. It is the most she has had in a match this year, and she missed on only one of her 14 swings.

news.headline: IUP wins twice in West Virginia
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks beat Shepherd and then Millersville on Friday and did not lose a set in either match. IUP has now won seven in a row and is 8-3.

news.headline: Delaney Concannon wins a conference weekly award
news.summary: Concannon had 49 kills and 52 digs across four wins at IUP's home tournament last weekend. She leads the Crimson Hawks with 105 kills through nine matches.

news.headline: Mets beat the Yankees 12-2 in the Bronx
news.summary: Francisco Lindor hit two home runs and drove in five runs Saturday afternoon at Yankee Stadium. Gerrit Cole gave up five runs in four and a third innings, and the Yankees are now 85-63.

news.headline: Bellinger homer lifts Yankees past the Mets
news.summary: Cody Bellinger hit a three-run home run in the second inning Friday night and the Yankees beat the Mets 6-4. New York is 85-62 and leads Boston by five and a half games for the first wild card spot.

news.headline: Chisholm goes on the injured list with a hurt thumb
news.summary: Jazz Chisholm sprained his thumb sliding into second base and will not play for at least a week. Jose Caballero is taking his place at second base.
